claude.sample_unit: US adult participants acting as hypothetical jurors

links.outcome: Perceived radiologist liability when AI error rates (FDR/FOR) disclosed to participants
links.effect: Providing participants with AI error rates, including FDR (p=0.0038) or FOR (p=0.0035), reduced perceived liability; radiologist awareness of error rates did not significantly change liability.
links.quote: Double-read workflows (p<0.0001), documenting initial interpretations (p=0.0125), and providing participants with AI error rates, including the FDR (p=0.0038) or FOR (p=0.0035), reduced perceived liability.

unlisted_practices: Double-read AI-human radiology workflow to reduce perceived malpractice liability
Documenting radiologist's initial interpretation before viewing AI output
Erroneous-change penalty: changing a correct interpretation after AI output raises liability
